setting: K=Q(sqrt(-3)), psi=1, ell>=5, even twist e>=2, generic position (ell-1) does not divide 2e; normalized residual triple after chi^-1 is chi^(e-1) direct sum chi^-1 direct sum chi^(-e-1).
algebra: Individual conjugate self-duality for each one-dimensional character chi^a in n=3 requires chi^a = chi^(-a-2) (since chi^c=chi), equivalently ell-1 divides 2(a+1). For extreme a=e-1 or a=-e-1 this is equivalent to ell-1 dividing 2e, CONTRARY to generic-position hypothesis. Middle a=-1 does satisfy. However the entire multiset is CSD because extremes are swapped. Thus 2020 Allen-Newton-Thorne Theorem 1.1(iv) cannot apply as stated on this generic input, independently of its Steinberg requirements (v),(vi)(c).
limitation: Assumes K cyclotomic disjointness for ell>=5 and the normalization of the residual triple given in incomplete human reconstruction. This algebra does not prove or disprove RH or the Lean development, and does not exclude a different automorphy theorem or a new argument.
